shortDescription: Manage the Docker daemon configuration file.

options.name: data_root
options.description: Directory where Docker stores its runtime data.

options.name: debug
options.description: Enables debug mode for the Docker daemon.

options.name: diff_output
options.description: Whether to include a diff of the configuration changes in the output.

options.name: dns
options.description: List of DNS servers for Docker containers.

options.name: hosts
options.description: List of Docker daemon host endpoints.

options.name: log_driver
options.description: Specifies the default logging driver for containers. Supported values include C(json-file), C(syslog), C(journald), C(local), and C(loki).

options.name: log_level
options.description: Sets the logging level for the Docker daemon.

options.name: log_opts
options.description: A dictionary of logging options for the specified log driver.

options.name: metrics_addr
options.description: Address where Docker metrics are exposed. Automatically enables experimental mode when defined.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the Docker configuration. C(present) creates or updates the configuration. C(absent) removes the configuration file.

options.name: storage_driver
options.description: Defines the storage driver used by Docker. Valid values include C(overlay2), C(zfs), C(btrfs), C(devicemapper), etc.
